title: Scheduled CI re-run + dependency version-bump + re-verification
context: Lessons rot as dependencies and upstream sources change. This recurring maintenance task schedules CI re-runs, bumps pinned dependency versions, and re-verifies lessons and the dataset gate.
objective: Add a scheduled CI job that re-runs all lessons, bumps pinned dependency versions, and re-verifies lesson execution and the dataset gate, catching lesson rot.
acceptanceCriteria: Scheduled CI re-runs all lessons in both tracks and re-runs the dataset-gate audit.
Dependency version bumps are proposed/applied with lockfiles updated and builds green.
Failures (lesson rot, broken dataset links) are surfaced clearly; reviewed by Technical; code licensed MIT.
resources: PLAN.md (binding cancer guardrails / Data, licensing & compliance)
